en.content:
If the variable line 3x + 4y = lies between the two
circles (x 1)2 + (y 1)2 = 1
and (x 9)2 + (y 1)2 = 4, without intercepting a chord on either circle, then the sum of all the integral values of is ___________.
en.explanation:
Both centers should lie on either side of the line as well as line can be tangent to circle.

(3 + 4 ) . (27 + 4 ) < 0

(7 ) . (31 ) < 0 (7, 31) ....... (1)

d1 = distance of (1, 1) from line

d2 = distance of (9, 1) from line

.... (2)

....(3)

(1) (2) (3) [12, 21]

Sum of integers = 165

en.content: The number of six letter words (with or without meaning), formed using all the letters of the word 'VOWELS', so that all the consonants never come together, is ___________.
en.explanation:
Total possible words = 6! = 720

When 4 consonants are together (V, W, L, S)
such cases = 3! ⋅ 4! = 144

All consonants should not be together

= Total All consonants together,

= 6! 3! 4! = 576
